volunteerExperiences.description: The coding program is a project-based hands on learning experience that aims to equip students with various digital tools in engineering and technology. Students will begin the coding program by learning the core concepts of Critical Media Literacy to provide them with the critical thinking tools prior to building practical technical skills. Through this lens, students will build their own projects focusing on themes that are relevant to their own lived experiences and will have an opportunity to showcase their work to their community and the public at large.
